# troid

> Prop-firm risk and compliance, computed. Size against both loss ceilings, net of fees.

Free. Never places orders. troid's own strategy shows no measurable edge.

troid is a free informational tool, not financial or investment advice. troid does not place trades or publish trade signals. Its shadow account is a simulated strategy, shown only after trades close. Prop-firm rules change without notice — verify every number with the firm before trading. troid is an independent affiliate of the firms it compares and earns a commission on purchases through its links; this does not affect the calculations or comparisons.

## Pages

- [troid's desk](https://troid.ai/): Prop-firm risk and compliance, computed. Size against both loss ceilings, net of fees.
- [troid's compare](https://troid.ai/compare): Daily limit, max loss, target, price and fees for each firm, with the document and the date troid read each rule. Nothing scored, nothing ranked.
- [troid's ledger](https://troid.ai/ledger): Simulated: every run and every closed trade of troid's shadow account, on api.binance.us bars. Hypothetical results: no money is traded, and nothing here is a signal.
- [troid's research](https://troid.ai/dashboard): The strategy review and the audit findings, each number with its tier. Nothing here is a signal.
- [tearsheet](https://troid.ai/tearsheet): quantstats over the shadow account's journal. Hypothetical performance, not a record of real trading.
- [ask troid](https://troid.ai/chat): troid's rule data with each rule's source and read date, arithmetic through tools. Not financial advice.
- [faq](https://troid.ai/faq): Pass rates, costs, why accounts fail and how sizing decides survival, each figure with its tier.
- [terms](https://troid.ai/terms): A free informational tool, not advice. Verify every number with the firm before trading.
- [sources](https://troid.ai/sources): Every outside figure troid uses, with who produced it, when troid read it, and its caveat.
- [Bitfunded's rules](https://troid.ai/firms/bitfunded): Bitfunded's loss limits, reset, fees and leverage from its own documents, each with the date troid read it. Nothing scored, nothing ranked.
- [BrightFunded's rules](https://troid.ai/firms/brightfunded): BrightFunded's loss limits, reset, fees and leverage from its own documents, each with the date troid read it. Nothing scored, nothing ranked.
- [Crypto Fund Trader's rules](https://troid.ai/firms/crypto-fund-trader): Crypto Fund Trader's loss limits, reset, fees and leverage from its own documents, each with the date troid read it. Nothing scored, nothing ranked.
- [troid Pro](https://troid.ai/pro): Saved accounts, rule-change alerts and a journal check, at $19/month. The free desk stays free.

## For assistants

- [TROID.md](https://troid.ai/TROID.md): troid's rules and arithmetic as one file — paste it into any assistant as a system prompt.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/kunjancollective/troid/tree/main/mcp): The same for Claude Desktop or Cursor, with exact arithmetic.
- [METHODOLOGY.md](https://troid.ai/METHODOLOGY.md): How numbers get onto a page, what tier each one carries, and every correction made since launch.
